narrative.intro: Akima Infrastructure Protection obligated $232M in FY2026 to date, across 11 awards with an average award size of $21.1M. Akima Infrastructure Protection's current-year obligations are up 36.0% year over year. Akima Infrastructure Protection received progressively larger obligations since FY21, moving from $0 in FY21 to $2M in FY22, $34.2M in FY23, $49.7M in FY24, and $170M in FY25 before reaching $232M in FY26. The reported figures are contract obligations except where noted otherwise for award-value tables. These current-year totals are partial because they reflect fiscal year to date activity. The distribution by fiscal year shows a sustained increase in obligations beginning in FY23 and accelerating in FY25 and FY26. The count and average award size indicate relatively large awards on a per-contract basis, given 11 awards and an average of $21.1M. Readers should treat the FY2026 total as a year-to-date figure that may change as the fiscal year progresses.
